metadata.name: GetBillPayPaymentHistory
metadata.description: Use this API  to get  the historical payment data of the payee.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: SubscriberID
request_fields.description: This is the Service Provider's (iPay Solutions) identifier  for the Cardholder User. Example : 12345678

request_fields.name: PayeeId
request_fields.description: This is the Payee identifier associated with the Payee or Transfer account for the Bill Pay Services API. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 20

request_fields.name: StartDate
request_fields.description: This is the date that designates the starting point for eBill [Due] date selections. If no Start Date is specified, the Bill Pay Services API will return all available eBills that have a Due Date that is less than the specified End Date. Format : YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss Example :2015-12-11T00:00:00

request_fields.name: EndDate
request_fields.description: This is the date that designates the ending point for eBill [Due] date selections. If no End Date is specified, the Bill Pay Services API will return all available eBills that have a Due Date that is greater than the specified Start Date. Format : YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss Example :2015-12-11T00:00:00

request_fields.name: MaxRecord
request_fields.description: This is  the maximum number of records to return in the response. If no number, or an invalid number, is provided in the search request,the Service Provider(iPay Solutions) will default this value to 50, and return a maximum of 50 records in the response. Example: 10,20,50.

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: PaymentId
children.description: This is the payment ID which is generated by Bill Payment Services. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 120 Note : PaymentID will be generated for only recurring payments.

children.name: PayeeId
children.description: This is the Payee identifier associated with the Payee or Transfer account for the Bill Pay Services API. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 20

children.name: PayeeName
children.description: This is the name of the Payee Example: Andrew Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PayeeNickName
children.description: This is the nickname for the Payee. Example: Andy

children.name: CategoryId
children.description: This is the name of the category assigned to the Payee or Transfer account Valid Values:0-9 Example: 2

children.name: PaymentProccessDate
children.description: This is the date the currently scheduled payment or Transfer is scheduled to be processed. Example: 2015-12-11T00:00:00 Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

children.name: PaymentDate
children.description: This is the date the currently scheduled payment or Transfer is estimated to be delivered to the Payee. Example: 2015-12-11T00:00:00 Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: This is the amount of the scheduled single or recurring payment(s) or Transfer(s). Example : 10.25

children.name: PaymentStatus
children.description: The status of the payment or Transfer. Valid Values :  All – All(default) Sched – Scheduled Pend – Pending PendSkip - Pending Skip PmtApprvReq - Payment Approval Required Stop - Payment Stop Example: Sched Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PaymentMethod
children.description: This is the payment method for the Payee or Transfer account associated with the scheduled payment or Transfer. Example: Chk, Elec. Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PaymentFrequencyType
children.description: This is the payment frequency for a recurring payment or recurring Transfer series. Example: Weekly, Monthly etc Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PaymentFrequencyValue
children.description: This is the payment frequency for a recurring payment or recurring Transfer series. Example: wed etc Allowable Values: 50

children.name: P2PType
children.description: This is the type of communication method to be used for person-to-person Payee contact. Valid Values: SMS , Email. Example: SMS , Email. Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PaymentIntentType
children.description: This represents the payment intention for the Payment(s) or Transfer(s). Valid Value - PayBill , Payment for a bill(default) Example: PayBill Allowable Values: 20

children.name: ISeBill
children.description: This payment is an eBill payment. Valid Values: true, false. Example: true, false. Allowable Values: 20
